Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
It depends on your room size and style priorities!
The extra $1.10/sq ft for Low Tide gets you 8" wide, 86 3/5" long planks with a brushed matte texture, creating a visually spacious, high-end look. High Five ($5.59/sq ft) uses slightly narrower 5 15/16" wide, 80" long planks with a smooth matte finish, but gives you the exact same waterproof protection, durability, and non-toxic hardened wood construction.
